item_3_bakeoff_environment_fingerprint.resolved_is_NOT_used: The resolved path is recorded for provenance ONLY. Invoking it drops the venv, because a venv derives sys.prefix from argv[0]'s location plus pyvenv.cfg.
item_3_bakeoff_environment_fingerprint.rss_units_note: ru_maxrss is BYTES on Darwin, KILOBYTES on Linux. Each row carries rss_raw + rss_unit alongside rss_mb; do not compare rss_mb across platforms without checking rss_unit.
item_3_bakeoff_environment_fingerprint.rss_scope: RUSAGE_SELF measured INSIDE each child, i.e. per-process peak. NOT RUSAGE_CHILDREN, which is a running max across all children.
item_3_bakeoff_environment_fingerprint.timing_method: time.perf_counter() in the PARENT around subprocess.run of a fresh interpreter: wall-clock cold start including process spawn and import, single sample, no warm cache control.
item_3_bakeoff_environment_fingerprint.timing_caveats: Single unrepeated sample per library, same-machine, other processes not quiesced. Treat as order-of-magnitude only.
item_3_bakeoff_environment_fingerprint.isolation_flags: -I (isolated: no PYTHONPATH, no user site, no script dir)

item_5_ledger_key_mode.contradiction_the_reviewer_caught: An earlier report said ledger seq=36 was KEYED while also saying no key exists. Both were true of different records and the difference was never recorded. A durable record reading KEYED from a throwaway key is exactly what later reads as production authentication.
item_5_ledger_key_mode.repair: records now carry key_mode + key_fingerprint verbatim; verify() reports TEST_KEYED lines as NOT production authentication, and pre-field records as UNLABELLED-MODE to be treated as TEST_KEYED. History is annotated, never rewritten.

measured.seq_35_36: UNLABELLED-MODE (predate the field) -> treat as TEST_KEYED

item_5_ledger_key_mode.do_not_provision_yet: Agreed. A production secret must not be added until an untrusted workflow change cannot read or exfiltrate it — that means required reviewers on .github/**, no secret exposure to pull_request-triggered workflows, and least-privilege job permissions. Not built here.
